name: Clock Plus
author: Matt Wolfgang
description: This fork of the Omarchy Clock plugin adds timers, alarms, and a stopwatch to the calendar popup, with a live countdown in the bar. It is intended as a complete replacement for the built-in clock: enabling it takes the built-in's place in the bar and keeps your clock settings. Timers and alarms survive shell restarts, and a single service keeps them in sync across monitors.
